o.text: Ultimately from Ancient Greek χυμεία (khumeía), via Arabic كيمياء (kīmiyāʔ).
Derivation of Proto-Common Turkic *beŋ, possibly from Proto-Common Turkic. Cognate with Turkish ben, possibly cognate with Chuvash мин (min, “face colour, blush; rash”).

Derivation of Proto-Turkic *kūrï- (“dry”).
Cognate with
Karakhanid [script needed] (qurut, “qurut”); Southern Altai курут (kurut),
Tatar корт (qort), Kazakh құрт (qurt), Kyrgyz курут (kurut), Uzbek qurt, Turkmen gurt, Khakas хурут (xurut), Tuvan курут (kurut, “dried cheese”).
Borrowed from Russian гидробиология (gidrobiologija). By surface analysis, hidro- + biologiya (“biology”).
